content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"The AC/MC-130J program is a crewed special-operations aircraft modification line run by U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM).","citation":{"fact_id":"41e0193fddc23840"}},{"text":"It funds the rapid fielding of advanced strike and survivability capabilities for Special Operations Forces (SOF) AC-130J and MC-130J aircraft, which replace the retired AC-130U/H/W and MC-130E/P/H fleets.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"AC-130J \"Ghostrider\" aircraft perform strike missions, including close air support (CAS), air interdiction, and armed reconnaissance.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"MC-130J \"Commando II\" aircraft perform special-operations-peculiar mobility missions such as low-level infiltration, exfiltration, and resupply of SOF, plus air refueling for SOF helicopters and tiltrotor aircraft.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"The U.S. Air Force procures and fields the basic C-130J aircraft, common support equipment, and Weapon System Trainers, while USSOCOM modifies those aircraft with mission systems integrated through the Special Mission System.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"Modifications for MC-130J include Airborne Mission Networking (AbMN) to connect into the Department of Defense's Joint All-Domain Command and Control construct, the Silent Knight Radar (SKR) enabling terrain following/terrain avoidance in contested operations, and a defensive countermeasures suite with integrated electronic warfare capability.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"MC-130J aircraft that receive the AbMN, terrain following/avoidance, and radio-frequency countermeasures modifications are designated with the popular name \"Combat Talon III.\"","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"Beginning in FY 2025, funding transitioned from P-1 Line Item 5000C13000 / C-130 Modifications into this AC/MC-130J line item, because USSOCOM only employs AC/MC-130J aircraft after retiring the remainder of the legacy C-130 fleets in FY 2023.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"Integrating and automating SOF mission systems is described as critical to recapitalizing the retired USSOCOM C-130 fleet, reducing required crew size, and making SOF more lethal, resilient, survivable, agile, and responsive.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"The line item also funds communications security and joint/coalition interoperability efforts, including cryptographic modernization and low-cost modifications to improve reliability, maintainability, mission effectiveness, and safety.","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}},{"text":"For FY 2024, actual spending on the program totaled about $312.9 million (312,921 in USD thousands).","citation":{"fact_id":"21b60b16d442be44"}},{"text":"The FY 2025 enacted amount was about $286.3 million (286,263 in USD thousands).","citation":{"fact_id":"2ff08c1346541aa2"}},{"text":"The FY 2026 total request drops to about $236.3 million (236,312 in USD thousands), a decline from prior years.","citation":{"fact_id":"e1f922e8f4b072c3"}},{"text":"The FY 2026 discretionary request of about $236.3 million and the FY 2026 total request are the same figure.","citation":{"fact_id":"9b4995dd7c6b9ec1"}},{"text":"Cumulative funding across all prior years is reported at about $1,352.3 million (1,352.261 in USD millions).","citation":{"fact_id":"97e890b9d0bdf69d"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The program is funded through the Procurement, Defense-Wide account and organized under SOCOM.","citation":{"fact_id":"c83cb28e0f2d5255"}},{"text":"The USSOCOM Silent Knight Radar program office executed a 3-year Multiyear Procurement contract that stabilized the radar's price from FY 2021 through FY 2023, and awarded a 5-year Multiyear Procurement contract in FY 2024 to maintain a stabilized price, supporting a FY 2024 through FY 2028 procurement for the MC-130J.","citation":{"fact_id":"907ecd60c9349be4"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
